title: Recover DAG and Sample from Intervened Bayesian Network
query:
Recover the underlying DAG from the data in /app/bn_sample_10k.csv. The original DAG has U with no parents, exactly six total edges, and for any edge not involving U whose directionality is unclear, assume the node whose label comes first alphabetically is the child of the node whose label comes second. Save the edges of the recovered DAG to /app/learned_dag.csv in the format:
to,from
A,B
C,D
...
Then learn a Bayesian Network from /app/bn_sample_10k.csv using the recovered DAG. Perform a causal intervention on Y, setting its value to 0.0 (if exact-value intervention is not supported, use an extremely small variance of 10e-9 around 0.0). Save the edges of the intervened BN to /app/intervened_dag.csv in the same to,from format. Sample 10,000 points from the intervened BN and save the result to /app/final_bn_sample.csv with the same column names as the original data.
